<?php
/**
 * Light and dark mode for the whole site, like NexURLs.
 *
 * One choice everywhere: the header and pages, App Home, the plan and tool pages,
 * the menus and the community (its own Light, Dark or Auto setting is the same choice).
 *   signed in: the member's saved choice (the community profile's theme_pref)
 *   otherwise: what this browser picked last (localStorage qcf_theme)
 *   nobody picked: light, except in the app, where it follows the phone until they pick
 * A sun and moon button sits in the header next to search. Colours are in assets/cc-dark.css.
 */
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) exit;

class CCT_Theme {

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'wp_enqueue_scripts', [ __CLASS__, 'css' ], 99 );
		add_action( 'wp_head', [ __CLASS__, 'boot' ], 1 );
		add_action( 'wp_footer', [ __CLASS__, 'boot' ], 1 );
	}

	private static function css_url() {
		$f = dirname( __DIR__ ) . '/assets/cc-dark.css';
		return CCT_URL . 'assets/cc-dark.css?ver=' . CCT_VERSION . '.' . ( file_exists( $f ) ? filemtime( $f ) : 0 );
	}

	public static function css() {
		wp_enqueue_style( 'cct-dark', self::css_url(), [], null );
	}

	/** The member's own saved choice: '' (never picked), light, dark or auto. */
	private static function pref() {
		if ( ! is_user_logged_in() ) return '';
		global $wpdb;
		$t = $wpdb->prefix . 'qcf_user_profiles';
		$s = $wpdb->suppress_errors( true );
		$p = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT theme_pref FROM {$t} WHERE user_id = %d", get_current_user_id() ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$wpdb->suppress_errors( $s );
		return in_array( $p, [ 'light', 'dark', 'auto' ], true ) ? $p : '';
	}

	public static function boot() {
		static $done = false;
		if ( $done || is_admin() ) return;
		$done   = true;
		$logged = is_user_logged_in();
		if ( ! wp_style_is( 'cct-dark', 'done' ) && ! wp_style_is( 'cct-dark', 'enqueued' ) ) {
			echo '<link rel="stylesheet" id="cct-dark-late" href="' . esc_url( self::css_url() ) . '">';
		}
		$js = base64_decode( '' );
		$js = str_replace(
			[ '__PREF__', '__API__', '__NONCE__' ],
			[ wp_json_encode( self::pref() ), wp_json_encode( $logged ? esc_url_raw( rest_url( 'qcf/v1/profiles/me' ) ) : '' ), wp_json_encode( $logged ? wp_create_nonce( 'wp_rest' ) : '' ) ],
			$js
		);
		echo '<script id="cct-theme-js">' . $js . '</script>';
	}
}
CCT_Theme::init();
